summary: Iteration 99: Validated 5 new features - (1) Esqueci minha senha modal on Login page, (2) Cadastro dropdown with INDIVIDUAL and SOU DONO options, (3) EnquetesSection buttons with strong violet/red colors, (4) StoriesBar Avatar with profile photo, (5) Strava authorize uses get_current_user. All features working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: LoginPage.js - VERIFIED: 'Esqueci minha senha' button (data-testid='btn-esqueci-senha') opens modal with email input and 'Enviar Nova Senha' button
auth_routes.py - VERIFIED: POST /auth/recuperar-senha endpoint returns {success: true} for both valid and invalid emails (security best practice)
CadastroPage.js - VERIFIED: Dropdown shows 'INDIVIDUAL' (data-testid='option-individual') and 'SOU DONO DE UMA ASSESSORIA / EQUIPE' (data-testid='option-dono-assessoria')
CadastroPage.js - VERIFIED: Selecting 'SOU DONO' shows assessoria fields (nome, estado, cidade, foto, bio)
EnquetesSection.jsx - VERIFIED: 'Adicionar opção' button has strong violet colors (border-violet-500 text-violet-300 bg-violet-600/20)
EnquetesSection.jsx - VERIFIED: 'Cancelar' button has strong red colors (border-red-500/50 text-red-400)
StoriesBar.jsx - VERIFIED: Avatar uses AvatarImage with getFullPhotoUrl(autor.autor_foto) for profile photos
feed_routes.py - VERIFIED: GET /feed/stories returns 'autor_foto' field for each author (line 1386)
strava_routes.py - VERIFIED: GET /strava/authorize uses get_current_user dependency (not require_premium_access)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 99 validated 5 new features: (1) Password recovery modal on login page with POST /api/auth/recuperar-senha endpoint, (2) Cadastro dropdown with INDIVIDUAL and SOU DONO DE UMA ASSESSORIA options, (3) EnquetesSection buttons with strong violet/red colors, (4) StoriesBar Avatar with profile photo from autor_foto field, (5) Strava authorize endpoint uses get_current_user instead of require_premium_access.
